mapper.insert: insert into basket_match_status_log (match_id, before_status, after_status, change_type, change_reason, operator_id, operator_name, change_time, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{matchId}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{changeType}, #{changeReason}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{changeTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select id, before_status, after_status, change_type, change_reason, operator_id, operator_name, change_time from basket_match_status_log where match_id = #{matchId} and is_delete = 0 order by change_time desc, id desc
